notes: churned is defined as the bottom 20th percentile of total_playtime_value (src/features.py). total_playtime_value, avg_session_length, and playtime_per_game are all directly derived from that same column -- this is documented label circularity, not a genuine behavioral signal. See README.md.

metrics are read from the saved model artifact (models/churn_model.pkl), computed at training time on its held-out validation split. This script does not retrain the model; permutation importance is computed on a validation split reproduced with the same split parameters (test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=churned) used at training time.
